description: Plain-language findings from the birth chart for one area of life: how strong the area's main house is, the planet that guides it and where it sits, the other houses and planets for the area, support from planets (strong, mixed or needs effort), and whether the running life chapter touches the area. Areas: career, relationships, wealth, home_property, children, education, foreign_settlement, spiritual_growth. Health is not covered. Up to 3 answers per chart every 6 hours, shared with chart_overview and current_chapter. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer; a one-way code is kept for 6 hours to apply fair-use limits.

area.description: One of: career, relationships, wealth, home_property, children, education, foreign_settlement, spiritual_growth.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as recorded, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

name: life_area
title: Life area evidence
